description: This file defines a class 'EmailTemplates' in the 'Step\Acceptance' namespace, containing methods for acceptance testing related to email template creation within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods to automate the creation of email templates by interacting with UI elements during tests.

classes.name: EmailTemplates
classes.description: Acceptance test helper class for email template creation, extends AcceptanceTester and provides methods to automate interaction with email template UI in automated tests.

methods.name: createEmailTemplate
methods.description: Automates the process of creating a new email template by interacting with UI elements, filling in template details, and saving the template during acceptance tests.
